## 题目
Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix
\[
\begin{bmatrix}
0&-4&0\\
-8&-4&8\\
-4&-4&4
\end{bmatrix},
\]
with eigenvalues ordered \(\lambda_1<\lambda_2<\lambda_3\).

## 解法
线性空间解法（over \(\mathbb R\)）。  
Let \(T:\mathbb R^3\to\mathbb R^3\) be the linear map whose standard-basis representation is the given matrix:
\[
T(x,y,z)=(-4y,\,-8x-4y+8z,\,-4x-4y+4z).
\]
A scalar \(\lambda\) is an eigenvalue if \(\ker(T-\lambda I)\ne\{0\}\). The characteristic polynomial is
\[
\chi_T(t)=\det(tI-T)
=\det\begin{bmatrix}
t&4&0\\
8&t+4&-8\\
4&4&t-4
\end{bmatrix}
=t(t-4)(t+4).
\]
Thus the eigenvalues, from smallest to largest, are
\[
\lambda_1=-4,\qquad \lambda_2=0,\qquad \lambda_3=4.
\]

For each eigenspace:

- For \(\lambda=-4\):
\[
(T+4I)(x,y,z)=(4x-4y,\,-8x+8z,\,-4x-4y+8z)=0,
\]
so \(x=y=z\). Hence
\[
E_{-4}=\operatorname{span}\{(1,1,1)\}.
\]

- For \(\lambda=0\):
\[
T(x,y,z)=(-4y,\,-8x-4y+8z,\,-4x-4y+4z)=0,
\]
so \(y=0\) and \(x=z\). Hence
\[
E_0=\operatorname{span}\{(1,0,1)\}.
\]

- For \(\lambda=4\):
\[
(T-4I)(x,y,z)=(-4x-4y,\,-8x-8y+8z,\,-4x-4y)=0,
\]
so \(y=-x\) and \(z=0\). Hence
\[
E_4=\operatorname{span}\{(1,-1,0)\}.
\]

## 约定
特征向量可相差非零标量倍；本解答在每个一维特征子空间中选取首非零坐标 \(x=1\) 的代表元。

来源：自行选取

## 答案
\[
\lambda_1=-4,\quad v_1=\begin{bmatrix}1\\1\\1\end{bmatrix},
\]
\[
\lambda_2=0,\quad v_2=\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\\1\end{bmatrix},
\]
\[
\lambda_3=4,\quad v_3=\begin{bmatrix}1\\-1\\0\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：标量（特征值）与基/特征向量
- 结论：-4 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 1 | -1 | 0
- 约定：特征向量取一维特征子空间中以首非零坐标 \(x=1\) 的代表元
- 约定来源：自行选取

## 检验
\[
T(1,1,1)=(-4,-4,-4)=-4(1,1,1),
\]
\[
T(1,0,1)=(0,0,0)=0(1,0,1),
\]
\[
T(1,-1,0)=(4,-4,0)=4(1,-1,0).
\]
因此所得向量分别满足 \(T(v_i)=\lambda_i v_i\)。
